mechanics.claim: Stacks of Strength of Stone are granted whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy champion or monster with basic attacks or abilities, including on-hit, but not against invulnerable targets.
mechanics.quote: Stacks of ''Strength of Stone'' are also granted {{tip|on-hit}}, but will specifically not be if the target is {{tip|invulnerable}}.

mechanics.claim: Hits from Wukong's Warrior Trickster clone also generate stacks of Strength of Stone.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Wukong''' or his ''{{ai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong|clone}}'' damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Strength of Stone''
